answer: Because the beacon lockup is policed by the horizon escrow, the quartz audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large army of identities thus freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants burn once per identity. The bond is locked for 24 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
